verify_detail:
n.
- The one feature that is reachable (Catalog → Detail) has both a data-integrity bug (wrong item shown) and a fatal crash on its primary action button.
- These are not edge cases — they are hit via the app's main, first-screen navigation.

Recommend blocking release and filing bugs against: Home screen button wiring (`Screens.kt`, Home composable), Catalog list item click/index handling (`Screens.kt`, Catalog composable), and `ExportPolicy.export()` initialization (`ExportPolicy.kt:11`)."
